prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.8% vs -6.2%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 2 winning tests (+8.0% and +4.1%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.9% after noise correction, 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Selection Guidance Tip: Add an explicit guidance hint card on the pet selection screen explaining companion trait differences. (why: Adoption drop-off is severe (60.9%) with high time spent (mean 1017s), indicating decision paralysis when choosing a friend.)
1: [home, wait_info] Generation Status Progress Tracker: Add a prominent animated progress indicator and tip carousel to the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, leading to user anxiety and drop-off during background pet generation.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Story Scroll Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a full story scroll layout showcasing companion journey options. (why: Choose path drops conversion to 76.2% with a long tail mean time of 514s, showing users need clearer engagement right at entry.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Post Intro Desktop Readiness Confirmation: Add a new readiness verification screen (new_desktop_ready) after home_intro to confirm the pet is visible on screen before finishing. (why: Support mail logged 3 issues regarding pets not appearing on the desktop or users unable to launch them after onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Screen Compact Social Layout: Reframe the sign_in screen with a compact layout explicitly assuring secure account backup and persistent sync. (why: Support mail received 8 reports of missing/reset pets after re-authenticating, showing user anxiety around account persistence.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Personality Matching Stage: Insert a short personality preference quiz screen (new_pet_quiz) right before pick_friend to guide pet selection. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and takes long (mean 1017s), pointing to user hesitation when selecting a pet.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Control Overview Copy: Update home_intro body and hint text with step-by-step guidance on desktop interaction, hiding, and system tray management. (why: Support received multiple tickets (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
7: [home, notification] Pet Generation Completion Desktop Notification: Enable native desktop notification trigger options on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes. (why: Waiting step takes high mean time (2336s), so alerting users when background processing finishes prevents drop-off.)
8: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Step Relocation After Upload Photos: Move the sign_in step to occur right after photo upload and before adoption certificate generation. (why: Lessons show sign_in step reordering produced positive lifts (+8.0% and +4.1%) when placed later in the creation flow.)

scores.note: High drop-off step (60.9% conversion); guidance hint helps alleviate decision paralysis without adding new screens.
Addresses long waiting times during pet asset rendering with UI progress indicators.
Full redesigns on choose_path carry risk and lack strong historical success; high development cost.
Adding new screens to finish stage has mixed/negative historical evidence (-0.3% average) and adds friction.
Strong support evidence (8 reports) regarding account persistence concerns; layout adjustment is low cost.
Targets high drop-off step but introducing a new flow step adds user friction (historical new_flow was -8.3%).
Config/copy change directly addressing support tickets regarding post-onboarding pet control.
Re-engages users during long background processing (mean wait 2336s) via native notifications.
Strongest historical backing (5 tests, +2.9% mean, top wins +8.0% and +4.1%) and config-only change.
